## Install

Download and extract the Windows x64 zip, then run `AntiNotepad.exe`. The app is unsigned, so Windows may show a warning. Existing notes remain in their configured folder. See `README-portable.txt` in the zip for backup and removal guidance.

## Requirements

Windows 11 x64. The zip includes the .NET runtime.

## Checksums

Download `SHA256SUMS.txt` alongside the zip and compare its SHA-256 value with the downloaded file.
